legend: Twenty-one species are aligned in one fixed phylogenetic order across reproductive strategy, conditional genome size, dnaPipeTE composition, and RepeatMasker low-divergence signal. Panel a is a topology-only prune of the supplied species tree; branch lengths are omitted because the tree's publication, calibration, and time provenance remain unresolved. Panel b shows D. fuscus assembly-anchored IOD-derived pg/1C estimates and conditional intervals; crosses flag the prespecified image-quality balance caution and triangles flag one-image, one-animal support. These are not independently measured species C-values, and intervals exclude anchor uncertainty. Panel c shows broad-order shares of classified dnaPipeTE aligned bases. Panel d shows the same assay at the nine most abundant superfamilies, with bar height on one common scale. Panel e shows the RepeatMasker-aligned fraction below 5% sequence divergence for LTR, LINE, TIR, and all other annotations. dnaPipeTE composition and RepeatMasker landscape denominators are distinct; neither is genome occupancy, and divergence is not insertion age.

Every row follows the same supplied-tree order, and symbols expose genome-size support cautions.

legend: Panel a shows a topology-only 30-tip prune of the supplied 46-tip species tree; branch lengths are omitted because its publication or archive identifier, calibration method, and branch-length provenance remain unresolved. Species rows are derived from the plotted tip-y order and therefore follow the shared canonical phylogenetic order. Panel b shows the zero-aware terminal:internal LTR depth proxy across the exact 380-element primary branch. Hollow points are element-level observations, blue points are species medians, and horizontal blue intervals are 2,000-replicate element-bootstrap intervals. Elements are not biological replicates, and intervals are conditional on the recovered elements and sequencing resources. Elements were retained inclusively within each species' two-sided 1.5-IQR fences and only when the left LTR, right LTR, and internal region each had at least 80% positive-depth coverage. The primary branch derives from 408 LTR/Gypsy candidates at least 3,000 bp long with at least five correctly parsed TEsorter domain annotations. The dotted line marks equal terminal and internal mean depth (1:1); values to its right point in the direction expected under internal-sequence depletion. The tree supplies context and ordering only; this mapping/deletion-footprint proxy is not a phylogenetic analysis or an estimate of an ectopic-recombination, solo-LTR, or DNA-loss rate.
